summary: Correlate unavailable ancestry diagnostics with each request authorization decision

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Ancestry failures, worker generation verification and request authorization retain their existing conditions and results. No service-manager or EACCES exception grants or suppresses authority.

compatibility.detail: Ancestry failures are reported after each request authorization decision with connector PID and accept-time generation, method, path, cause and decision. Admitted GET/HEAD and independently verified worker requests use debug level; refusals and other admissions use warning level. Repeated cause/decision pairs are suppressed within a minute and the next report includes the suppressed count. The limiter retains at most 1024 keys; unseen keys beyond capacity are logged without suppression.

downtime.detail: The logging change takes effect on daemon restart; no migration is required.

manual.detail: No configuration changes are required. Queries, headers, bodies and environment values are not included in diagnostics.
